cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Stay until sunset. Gran predicted this stone would hatch, and I promised we'd witness the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's down. It's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then help me record that it didn't hatch. We can put the prophecy to rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we ring her and agree a deadline. I can't witness every sunset alone.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes from watching indefinitely to setting a deadline because B4 exposes the open date.
